description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the MedicationDispenseService in the OpenMRS project, focusing on CRUD operations, criteria-based retrieval, and void/unvoid functionalities.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for unit testing the MedicationDispenseService, including methods for getting, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and purging MedicationDispense records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data and index before each test execution.

methods.name: getMedicationDispense_shouldGetExistingMedicationDispense
methods.description: Tests retrieving a MedicationDispense by its ID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByUuid_shouldGetExistingMedicationDispense
methods.description: Tests retrieving a MedicationDispense by its UUID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria_shouldGetByPatient
methods.description: Tests fetching MedicationDispenses filtered by patient.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria_shouldGetByEncounter
methods.description: Tests fetching MedicationDispenses filtered by encounter.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria_shouldGetByDrugOrder
methods.description: Tests fetching MedicationDispenses filtered by drug order.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria_shouldIncludedVoided
methods.description: Tests retrieving all MedicationDispenses including voided ones.

methods.name: saveMedicationDispense_shouldSaveNewMedicationDispense
methods.description: Tests saving a new MedicationDispense record.

methods.name: saveMedicationDispense_shouldUpdateExistingMedicationDispense
methods.description: Tests updating an existing MedicationDispense record.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense_shouldNotChangeVoidedPropertiesIfAlreadyVoided
methods.description: Tests that voiding an already voided MedicationDispense does not alter its voided properties.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense_shouldFailIfVoidReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that voiding requires a non-null reason.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense_shouldFailIfVoidReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that voiding requires a non-empty reason.

methods.name: unvoidMedicationDispense_shouldUnvoidSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests unvoiding a previously voided MedicationDispense.

methods.name: purgeMedicationDispense_shouldRemoveFromDatabase
methods.description: Tests deleting a MedicationDispense from the database.
